prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long straight golden blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin vintage light ash-grey stretch denim with white fade creases at the hips and waist with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button, the two sides of the vintage grey denim fully covering her bust, two large round cutouts, each about the size of a hand, at the left and right of her waist, the skin inside each bare, framed by a clean edge of the vintage grey denim, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the vintage grey denim shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and a small mole near her collarbone. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin vintage grey denim molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the clean round edges of the two waist cutouts, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, white fade creases radiating at the hips and waist, fine stretch lines and a softly worn surface. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy light ash grey leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each longer than her middle finger, in light ash grey lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a grand museum hall with a pale stone floor, tall columns, a wide staircase of standard steps and plain banners without any text, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
